reason: I'd download it and use the 3 free fragments a day, maybe start the 7-day trial and cancel it before it charges, same as always. Between that, YouTube and ChatGPT voice I can practise for free, and I'm not spending my own $5 a month on pronunciation alone when it doesn't even check grammar or vocabulary.
objection: Can an app really score my pronunciation accurately? A score of 0–100 for each sound isn't my IELTS band, so how do I know it's right and not just a number?
would_change_my_mind: If people in my IELTS Telegram chats said their real Speaking band went up after using it, plus a one-time price of about $10 for the 2–3 months until my exam instead of a subscription.
